pages.text: The Akaishi Compressor presses dust and crystals into solid blocks. One input slot and one output slot; power is the only other requirement. Each operation takes 100 ticks at 15 energy/tick with a 100k internal buffer.$(br2)$(bold)Key recipes:$(reset)$(li)Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Lapis, Diamond, Emerald or Quartz Dust → 9 press into the matching block$(li)9 Netherite Dust → 1 Netherite Ingot (an ingot, not a block)$(li)4 Obsidian Dust → 1 Obsidian$(li)9 Akaishi Dust → 1 Akaishi Essence$(li)9 Akaishi Crystals → 1 Akaishi Crystal Block$(br2)Note: the Akaishi Crystal Block is produced only here; 9 crystals in a crafting table produce a Raw Akaishi Block instead.

Dust sources are described in the $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) entry: Akaishi Ore first grinds into Compressed Akaishi Essence, and pulverizing that concentrate yields Akaishi Dust. The complete dust list is in $(l:akaishi:dusts)Dusts$(/l), and crystal refining is covered in $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).
